description: Standardized evaluation package for selective human review and uncertainty estimation in industrial anomaly detection

data.historical_exposure_warning: Evaluated on historically exposed 1,725 MVTec AD test split. Must be replicated on independent VisA / BTAD datasets prior to journal submission.

candidate_policies.name: Uniform Random Selection
candidate_policies.description: Uniformly samples images up to review budget B

candidate_policies.name: Highest Anomaly Score
candidate_policies.description: Ranks images by raw anomaly score descending (favors severe obvious defects)

candidate_policies.name: Supervised Prediction Margin
candidate_policies.description: Ranks images by closeness to 0.5 classification threshold: u = 1 - |2p - 1|

candidate_policies.name: PatchCore Distance to Category Threshold
candidate_policies.description: Ranks images by inverted absolute distance to category p99 threshold: 1 / (|score - tau_c| + eps)

candidate_policies.name: Calibrated Patch-Neighborhood Dispersion (CPND)
candidate_policies.description: Theoretical metric based on k-NN distance dispersion in PatchCore FAISS memory bank. Requires implementation and ablation against simpler baselines.

statistical_evaluation.sampling_unit_rationale: Resampling at the image level preserves independent Bernoulli trials per inspection while computing standard error of error capture rate across industrial production batches.
